id: # steps are separated by a pipe. Write each step as one instruction.

name: Improved clinch
use: Tying a hook to mono or fluorocarbon
steps: Pass 6 inches of line through the hook eye.|Twist the tag around the standing line five times.|Bring the tag back through the loop above the eye.|Wet it and pull slowly until the coils bed down.
fail: If it slips you pulled it tight dry. Always wet it.
